diagnosis: The compiled frontier is thin while several grounded verification routes depend on scarce runtime capabilities (representative JavaScript browser or synchronized live contention). Two non-duplicated static verification shards can convert that evidence into useful claimable work without pretending to satisfy the live-only gates.
intervention: Materialized two bounded, deduplicated verification jobs: a V18 Cronograma static contract audit before browser verification, and a fixed-generation contention-fixture static consistency audit before spending more multi-worker race capacity.
tests: GitHub code search found no pre-existing matching dedupe keys or job ids before creation.
Both derived jobs were CREATEd successfully; the Facultad job required one same-payload retry after an unrelated branch-head movement.
Each job preserves the live/browser boundary instead of substituting static evidence for runtime evidence.
